title: License details
summary: DJDL's product page opened at its License section for Priya's Education license (the one licenses.detail shows): the tier pill at the top right of the License card, a term timeline for a one-year license that keeps the last version, no key because the access policy issued it, three add-ons with their source, Devices with its count in the nav, and What's New drawn from Markdown with its summary first. Each fact once: the Mac build is the tinted first row of one downloads table, the 1 GB is said once, in Cloud Sync's usage. The phone render shows a phone's state: DJDL has no phone build, so the action is Email me the download.
compare: Route #/p/djdl/license marks License in the in-page nav (from 1280 px) and in the jump bar (below 1280 px). One order everywhere: Get it, License, Devices, Cloud Sync, What's new, Help. Devices carries its count as the kit's neutral count after the label (ST-36).

Landing on a section route: the page opens scrolled so the License card's top sits just under the sticky header (under the jump bar below 1280 px), its outline flashes once for 1 s (no flash with reduced motion), and the mark holds on License until the person scrolls; after that it follows the reading line (PORTAL.md §4.20, owner polish 2026-10-07). Below 1280 px the marked pill is scrolled into view. The render shows the page from the top so the header can be checked.

Header (kit .product-hero): a centred 3:1 band of the cover capped at 416 px (16:9 full-bleed on phone), the 112 px icon (80 px on phone) about a third over its lower edge, the name (40/44) and 'by Example Audio' below the band, 12 px clear of it (8 on phone), never on the art; Download for macOS (solid, the page's only solid button) and the overflow menu. No status pill while the license is healthy.

Sizes (kit .product-layout, inside the portal's 1248 px content width): from 1280 px (desktop and wide) three columns, nav 148 px | main (Get it, Cloud Sync, What's new, Help) | side 384 px (License, Devices, DJDL knows you as, in the nav's order); tablet 1024–1279 two columns (main | 384 px) under the sticky jump bar; below 1024 px one column in the order Get it, License, Devices, Cloud Sync, DJDL knows you as, What's new, Help. Every card titles at 18/24, the page's block step; columns and cards are 24 apart.

License card header: 'License' (the page already says DJDL) and the tier as a neutral pill ('Education') at the top right, before any issue pill. No 'Licensed to' line: DJDL knows you as carries the email. No 'N of M devices' line in this card.

Term block (kit .license-term, LX-41 through LX-15): 'Updates until Sep 14, 2027', 'Then keeps working on the last version', a bar from activation to the end of updates with a 'Today, Oct 7' marker and a dashed 'Last version' stretch after the end date, then the status 'You're on the latest version' (Get it's head carries 4.2.0). No paragraph restating the title (owner, 2026-10-08: one sentence, in the reader's terms). The bar's track is visible in both themes (--pk-border-strong against the sunken box).

That wording appears only for keeps-the-last-version. A lifetime license shows 'Lifetime' and no bar; a renewing one 'Renews <date> · <source>'; a stop license at its end 'Renew with Example Audio to keep using it'.

Facts in two columns (.dl.cols): License source 'Automatic grant' (sentence case, copy catalog, P0-36), Works offline for (the license's own 14 days), Release track 'Stable' (singular for one track, 'Release tracks' only when there are several; the glossary word, not 'channels'), License key; then full-width Included. No Activated fact: the term bar starts at that date.
License key: 'None, sign in instead'. An automatic license has no key (LX-38), so no key field or masked key is drawn; DJDL knows you as names the account a new device signs in with.

Included lists the tier's entitlements by label on one line: '4 decks · Recording · Cloud Sync' (the 1 GB is said once, in Cloud Sync's usage). Add-ons is a table under the facts: each add-on by its own name over its term, its source in the Source column: Polaris VPN · Lifetime · Automatic grant; Stem separation · Ends Dec 31, 2026 · From Example Audio; Extra devices (2) · Lifetime · From Example Audio (LX-15). 'Apply to a license' is gone.

Devices: the head says '2 with Education, 2 from Extra devices' and carries '3 of 4 in use' with a four-segment meter (on a narrow card it drops under the title); one 56 px row per device with its 28 px tile, platform, version and 'this device' or last seen (never broken across lines), Remove per row. The word is device, never seat. What Remove does is said by its confirm panel, not by a note under the list.

Remove expands its row into the inline confirm panel (PORTAL.md §4.22; EXPERIENCE §7 L1/L2): 'Remove Gig laptop?', 'It's signed out of DJDL at once and 1 of 4 devices is free again.', on this device also 'You'll be signed out here too.', with Remove Gig laptop and Keep it, focus on the panel heading; then the toast 'Gig laptop removed'.

What's new in 4.2.0: the notes drawn from Markdown (kit .md: an h3 under the card's h2, bold, italic, a list, a link); the summary is the first list cut to three items, Show full notes opens the rest in place; Earlier versions as a compact table (version, released). No subtitle: Get it carries 4.2.0's date.

Get it: one downloads table (Platform, SHA-256, Download), each file once. The build for this Mac is the tinted first row, 'For your Mac · .dmg · 84 MB', with an outlined Download (the header keeps the one solid button); no separate recommended panel repeating it. Each file has a truncated SHA-256 with copy; the foot holds the SHA256SUMS link and no note. No release-track picker, because this license runs Stable only; P2-13's Stable | Beta picker appears in the card header only when a license grants more.

Cloud Sync: '37 MB of 1 GB used' with its bar in the card head and no subtitle (the table names what syncs), then a compact table Synced data | Items | Size: Crates 1,240 31 MB; Cue points 18,920 tracks 6.2 MB; Settings 9 3 KB; then Export synced data and Delete synced data. On a narrow phone the two buttons wrap, Export first.

Delete synced data opens a ConfirmDialog with step-up and typed confirmation (EXPERIENCE §7 L3): 'Delete DJDL's synced data?', the consequences (37 MB of crates, cue points and settings leave Cloud Sync; files already on your Macs and PCs stay there), Export synced data offered first, 'Type DJDL to delete', and the button 'Delete synced data'.

Phone renders stand for a phone user agent (PORTAL.md §5.4, decided by the device, not the width): the header action is 'Email me the download' (solid, full width) with the line 'We'll email priya@example.edu a link for your Mac or PC.' under it (the downloads table names the platforms); the downloads table has no tinted row and no 'For your Mac'; Devices marks no 'this device' (Priya's MacBook Air reads 'last seen today').

Below 1280 px: the sticky jump bar of pills under the header scrolls sideways (no scrollbar, snap, a faded right edge) so What's new and Help stay reachable, License marked. Phone: the SHA-256 column hidden; the footer above the bottom bar, whose Activate is the outlined pill.

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Needs fixes, now applied: the light-theme duration track is drawn (3.2:1), the page has one solid button, and the phone state is designed; the scroll-following nav stays (owner polish) with the landing state specified.

findings.issue: Light theme: the duration bar's track was the box's own colour (rgb 235,238,248 on rgb 235,238,248).
findings.resolution: The duration box's track uses --pk-border-strong: sampled rgb(126,134,153) on rgb(235,238,248) in light (3.2:1) and rgb(97,105,123) on rgb(2,4,8) in dark (3.7:1). Same rule on portal.license-lapsed. licenses.detail is another area's screen and is not changed here.

findings.issue: Phone state not designed: 'Download for macOS', 'Recommended for your Mac' and a Mac marked 'this device' on a phone.
findings.resolution: Phone render: header 'Email me the download' (solid, full width); the recommended card becomes the callout 'DJDL runs on macOS and Windows · We'll email priya@example.edu a link that opens on your Mac or PC.', then All platforms; Priya's MacBook Air reads 'last seen today', not 'this device'. Compare line added.

findings.issue: Two solid violet Download buttons in the first screen.
findings.resolution: The recommended row's Download is outlined; the header's is the page's only solid button. The compare line says the real portal's recommended panel follows the same rule.

findings.issue: Route lands at the top of the page; the nav zigzags between columns and a scroll-spy can't mark one of two side-by-side sections.
findings.resolution: Partly declined: the nav keeps following the reading line and the side column starts beside Get it, because PORTAL.md §4.20's owner polish (2026-10-07) decides both. Applied: a compare line says a section route lands with the card's top under the sticky header, flashes its outline for 1 s (none with reduced motion) and holds the mark until the person scrolls; the render stays the top of the page so the header can be reviewed.

findings.issue: Devices subtitle broke at 'add- / on' and switched from 'devices' to 'seats'.
findings.resolution: '3 of 4 devices in use · 2 come with Education and 2 with the Extra devices add‑on' with a non-breaking hyphen; footnote 'Removing a device makes room for another at once and signs it out of DJDL.' No 'seat' is left in the copy or the compare list.

findings.issue: At 360 px 'Export synced data' and 'Delete synced data' were clipped.
findings.resolution: Cloud Sync's footer wraps, and below 380 px the two buttons stack full width, Export first. Checked at 360 and 390 px: no clipped text and no sideways scroll. Same on portal.license-lapsed.

findings.issue: Phone pill tabs used overflow: hidden, so What's new and Help could not be reached.
findings.resolution: The strip scrolls sideways (overflow-x auto, no scrollbar, scroll-snap x proximity) with a 40 px faded right edge; the compare list says the marked pill scrolls into view on load. Same on portal.license-lapsed.

findings.issue: Remove and Delete synced data had no confirmation or result specified.
findings.resolution: Compare lines added in the house patterns: Remove expands the row into the inline confirm panel (PORTAL.md §4.22; EXPERIENCE §7 keeps row-scoped confirms inline in the portal rather than a dialog) naming the device and the freed device, with the extra line on this device and the toast 'Gig laptop removed'; Delete synced data is an L3 ConfirmDialog with step-up and 'Type DJDL to delete', naming 37 MB and offering Export first.

findings.issue: 'Release tracks: Stable' for one value; 'Crates · 1,240 crates' and 'Settings · 9 settings' repeat the noun.
findings.resolution: 'Release track: Stable' (plural only for several); 'Crates · 1,240', 'Cue points · 18,920 tracks', 'Settings · 9'.
